setup: const users = useQuery({ queryKey: ["managed-identities", role, page], queryFn: () => api<{ items: ManagedUser[]; totalCount: number }>( `/admin/users?${new URLSearchParams({ role, page: String(page) })}`, ), });

const invite = useMutation({ mutationFn: () => api<void>("/admin/users/support-admins/invite", { method: "POST", body: JSON.stringify({ displayName, email }), }), onSuccess: () => { setDisplayName(""); setEmail(""); setNotice(t("accountIdentities.inviteSuccess")); refresh(); }, });

const changeEmail = useMutation({ mutationFn: (id: string) => api<void>(`/admin/users/${id}/email-change/request`, { method: "POST", body: JSON.stringify({ newEmail: newEmails[id] }), }), onSuccess: (_, id) => { setNewEmails((value) => ({ ...value, [id]: "" })); setNotice(t("accountIdentities.emailSuccess")); }, });

const resend = useMutation({ mutationFn: (id: string) => api<void>(`/admin/users/support-admins/${id}/resend-activation`, { method: "POST", }), onSuccess: () => setNotice(t("accountIdentities.resendSuccess")), });

const freeze = useMutation({ mutationFn: ({ id, frozen }: { id: string; frozen: boolean }) => api<void>(`/admin/users/${id}/freeze`, { method: "POST", body: JSON.stringify({ frozen }), }), onSuccess: refresh, });

const revokeSupportAccess = useMutation({ mutationFn: (id: string) => api<void>(`/admin/users/support-admins/${id}/revoke-authority`, { method: "POST", }), onSuccess: () => { setNotice(t("accountIdentities.revokeSuccess")); refresh(); }, });
types: type ManagedUser = { id: string; displayName: string; email: string; emailConfirmed: boolean; isFrozen: boolean; mustChangePassword: boolean; };
props: onClick={() => { if ( window.confirm( user.isFrozen ? t("accountIdentities.reactivateConfirmation") : t("accountIdentities.freezeConfirmation"), ) ) freeze.mutate({ id: user.id, frozen: !user.isFrozen }); }}
onClick={() => { if ( window.confirm( t("accountIdentities.revokeConfirmation", { name: user.displayName, }), ) ) revokeSupportAccess.mutate(user.id); }}
